statement: Cuneiform is classified by current scholarship as (probably) INDEPENDENT: the only major early writing tradition, alongside Chinese and Mesoamerican scripts, generally accepted as having no antecedent contact-based model. The positive evidentiary basis is a multi-millennium local "token-to-tablet" continuity: small clay counting tokens (attested from the Neolithic, 8th millennium BCE) evolving through sealed clay envelope-bullae into flat impressed/incised tablets, entirely within Mesopotamia, with no comparable intermediate stage found anywhere else prior.

interpretations.position: Tokens directly and mechanically became writing via bullae-impression (strong continuity thesis)

holders.name: Denise Schmandt-Besserat
holders.work: Before Writing (1992); How Writing Came About (1996)

interpretations.strongest_case: A documented, traceable multi-millennium sequence from Neolithic clay tokens through sealed bullae to flat impressed tablets, entirely within Mesopotamia.

interpretations.position: The token-shape/meaning correlations are overgeneralized across too vast a span of time and geography, and the strong direct-descent mechanism is not established outside a narrow window

holders.name: Jean-Jacques Glassner
holders.work: The Invention of Cuneiform: Writing in Sumer (Johns Hopkins UP, 2003; French orig. 2000)

interpretations.strongest_case: Archaeological context for most tokens is unrecoverable; the chronology (envelopes reliably predating writing) is not established from the Eastern Mediterranean to the Indus; the token system is only one strand feeding into writing, alongside pictography and seal practice.

does_not_demonstrate: That every individual token/tablet find independently corroborates the general theory
That the mechanism is settled consensus rather than a broadly-accepted core insight with a contested strong version
adversarial_counter: The broadly accepted claim ("writing grew out of accounting/counting practice") should not be conflated with the specific, more contested claim ("tokens were mechanically converted into writing via bullae-impression") — this project has previously mis-stated a similarly narrow methodological finding as a settled conclusion (cf. CLAUDE.md's eleph-census pattern) and should not repeat it here.
notes: origin_type field itself (INDEPENDENT) is HIGH confidence; the Schmandt-Besserat mechanism specifically is DISPUTED — see interpretations[].
